faq: Do I need an app for this?
Often your theme or a recommendation app can do it. We pick the lightest option that meets your needs. If a paid app is best, we tell you the monthly cost before we install anything.
We keep the block light, load images lazily and test speed before and after. If a tool adds noticeable delay, we tell you and suggest another route.
Can I choose which products appear?
Yes. You can set rules by collection or tag, and Premium adds exclusions, so items such as gift cards or discontinued products never show up as suggestions.
What if my products have little data?
Clean tags and collections make suggestions better. If yours are thin, we add backup rules, and Catalog Data Setup is available as a separate service to improve the source data.

desc:
Related products on product pages show shoppers more items like the one they are viewing, so a single visit can lead to the right choice. Ecom Swift LLC adds the block, writes sensible rules, styles it to your theme and checks speed.

## Why product pages need a related block

A shopper on a product page often has a question the page cannot answer: is there a cheaper version, a different color or something slightly larger? If the next step is to go back and search again, many will not. A related products block gives them a short list of alternatives right where they are.

Without it, a page can become a dead end. The shopper either buys the one item or leaves, and you lose the chance to show something that fits better.

## What is a related products block?

A related products block is a row of items shown on a product page, chosen by rules such as same collection, similar price, shared tags or what other shoppers viewed. It is different from a frequently bought together block, which suggests companion items rather than alternatives.

## How related items influence browsing

Related items keep people exploring your catalog. A shopper who dislikes the color of a jacket can reach another jacket in one tap, and one who finds the price too high can see a cheaper option. Each click is a new chance to find the right match.

The effect depends on how good the rules are. A block that shows random items teaches shoppers to ignore it. A block built on clean tags, sensible price ranges and stock checks feels like a helpful shelf. We also check page speed, because a heavy block can slow the page it is meant to improve.

## What a good related block includes

- One clear block on every product page template.
- Rules by collection, tag and price range.
- Out of stock products hidden.
- A limit on the number of items, so the row stays scannable.
- Viewed together suggestions where your data supports them.
- Exclusions for products you never want shown.
- Backup items when a product has little data.
- Images, titles and prices styled to match your theme.
- A layout that scrolls or wraps well on phones.
- Click tracking so you can see what gets chosen.

## What we do

We begin by reviewing your catalog and how shoppers move between products. We choose rules that suit your range. A store with many sizes of one item needs different rules from a store with one of each.

We then build the block in your theme or configure it in your tool, apply your styling and test on desktop and phone. After launch we check page speed to confirm the block has not added drag. You receive short notes on how to adjust the rules yourself.

Basic covers a block with simple collection or tag rules. Standard adds price range rules, hiding of out of stock items, a larger row and a speed check. Premium adds viewed together suggestions, exclusions, backup items, click tracking and a period of tweaks afterward. You can add a recently viewed block, collection page suggestions or a tag cleanup as extras.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Keep tags consistent so rules work.
- Show items at a similar price.
- Test the block on a real phone.
- Check page speed after launch.
- Exclude accessories if you want alternatives only.

**Avoid:**
- Filling the row with unrelated products.
- Showing sold out items.
- Using huge images that slow the page.
- Adding several recommendation blocks that repeat each other.
- Leaving products with no tags.

## Who this is for

This service suits stores with many similar products, such as clothing, furniture or gadgets, and stores whose product pages end abruptly after the description. It also suits owners who tried an app, disliked the results and want a cleaner setup.

## What we need from you

Tell us how shoppers compare your products and any items to exclude. Share your theme name and, if you use one, your recommendation app. Give us access as a collaborator, staff or developer user, and never send a password. You approve the design on a preview first.
